title: heatTransferBench operation
description: Self-check of the heat-transfer correlation library against its own textbook worked examples: every built-in correlation is evaluated at its published example's conditions and held to the printed answer within a declared tolerance. Runs with NO configuration — the bench IS the test — and the tolerances exist only to honour textbook rounding and chart-reading scatter, never to loosen a failing correlation.

aadTolerance.title: Deviation tolerance
aadTolerance.description: Allowed relative deviation from the printed textbook value; defaults to 0.05.

aadTolerancePhaseChange.title: Phase-change tolerance
aadTolerancePhaseChange.description: Separate allowance for the boiling/condensation examples, whose published inputs are chart-read.

sweep.title: Reynolds-number sweep
sweep.description: Optional. Evaluate every single-phase Nusselt correlation on one logarithmic grid of Re at each declared Prandtl number and write one CSV row per (Pr, Re): each correlation's Nu and its own window flag. Each correlation is handed a unit fluid whose Re and Pr are the grid point, heating side; Kern is shell-side and is evaluated on the same numbers.

file.title: CSV file name
file.description: The CSV the sweep writes, in the case directory. A path into data/standards/ is refused.

ReMin.title: Lowest Reynolds number
ReMin.description: The first grid point. Must be positive: the grid is logarithmic and every correlation divides by Re.

ReMax.title: Highest Reynolds number
ReMax.description: The grid runs to the last point at or below this value; must exceed ReMin.

pointsPerDecade.title: Points per decade
pointsPerDecade.description: Re_k = ReMin 10^(k / pointsPerDecade): a whole number, so a decade that starts on a grid point ends on one.

Pr.title: Prandtl numbers
Pr.description: One curve per value; at least one, each > 0.
